title: cc vars
description: Variables for Unified C Compiler Router (cc)

CC_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for cc: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories, 'from-source' compiles from source archives, and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

CC_VERSION.description: Version of C Compiler to install

CC_BACKEND.description: Active C compiler backend routed by cc ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'edgcpp', 'custom-cc').

CC_PKG_MGR.description: Explicit package manager override for CC installation.

CC_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Bootstrap C toolchain used when building CC from source.

CC_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading cc binary or archive artifacts.

CC_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying cc available remote releases.
